main_text.l: בָּשַׁל Coqui; Maturescere: Coquere, Elixare, Pihel, בִּשֵּׁל Idem. Pyhal בָּשַׁל Coqui. Hiphil הִבְשִׁיל Coxit, Maturavit.
מְבַשְּׁלִים m.p. Coqui: מְבַשְּׁלוֹת Coqua, vel Culina.
בָּשָׂר m. Caro: plur. בְּשָׂרִים. Chald. בְּשַׂר.
בִּשֵּׂר Nunciavit, Annunciavit, Prædicavit, Evangelizavit. Hithpahel, הִתְבַּשֵּׂר Annunciari.
בַּת f. Bathus, mensura liquidorum: plural. בָּתִים. Chald. בַּתִּין Esr. 7. 22.
בְּתוּלָה בְּתוּל f. Virgo: plur. בְּתוּלוֹת.
בֶּתֶר m. Dissectio, Pars: plur. בְּתָרִים.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and dagesh marks are reconstructed from a low-resolution scan and may not match the printer exactly. Some Hebrew forms at line ends, especially the Chaldee forms and the plural forms in lines 16 and 17, are uncertain. The reference "Esr. 7. 22." is copied as printed. The Google digitiser mark at the bottom right was omitted.
